title: Grahams & Symington Family Estate Wine Dinner
description:
Symington Family Estates is one of the world's leading producers of premium port, the leading vineyard owner in the Douro Valley and one of the top Portuguese wine producers.

Join us for what will be a truly amazing evening. Due to last years success with this dinner we are running it again this year.

The evening will consist of some incredible Symington wines and of course Grahams Port to finish, all paired with a 4 course menu.
address: Hotel du Vin Birmingham, 25 Church St, Birmingham, B3 2NR

title: French Reds Wine Dinner
description:
France is one of the biggest wine-producing countries in the world and is home to some of the most prized and expensive wines in the world. Come and find out about the different wine regions and discover what makes French wines so special!

6 wonderful French red wines, to be tasted with a classic French dish, prepared by the chef at Hotel du Vin.

Please note, we can cater for dietary requirements such as vegan or vegetarian food, but we cannot guarantee that all the wines will be vegan.
address: Hotel du Vin Birmingham, 25 Church St, Birmingham, B3 2NR

title: Ribeye Steak and Red Wine Dinner
description:
We'll be tasting a fabulous range of red wines from all over the world. We will show how the wines really come to life when partnered with a succulent 250 g ribeye steak and chips from the team at Hotel du Vin.

Taste top class red wines (minimum six) all of which will show just how well these wines and steak partner so well.

Love red wine but not a meat eater? We can offer vegan and vegetarian meal alternatives for this event, but please note we cannot guarantee the wines will all be vegan or vegetarian friendly.

Please let us know if you have any dietary requirements upon booking if possible, but we do send out an email reminder in advance of the event.
address: Hotel du Vin Birmingham, 25 Church St, Birmingham, B3 2NR

title: Festive Wine Tasting Lunch - Birmingham
description:
The perfect Christmas day? Well you'll need some wine, so join us for a very special version of our Saturday wine tasting lunch to taste some excellent white and red wines perfect for the Christmas table. We will be giving you tips on which wines to serve on Christmas day and what food to pair each wine with. Some lovely wines to savour and enjoy accompanied with a 2 course festive meal from the chefs at Hotel du Vin.

We will start with a glass of Champagne, followed by a selection of white wines then reds (and maybe even something sweet), accompanied by a two course lunch.

Please note we can happily cater for vegetarian and vegan dietary requirements, however we cannot guarantee that the wines will be vegan/vegetarian. Please get in touch directly if you would like to discuss.
address: Hotel du Vin Birmingham, 25 Church St, Birmingham, B3 2NR

title: Saturday 2 course lunch - World of Wine
description:
Come and experience our most popular event - Starting with a glass of sparkling wine, with a delicious two-course lunch surrounded by 12 more superb wines. Friendly, informal and fun - no previous experience necessary - Relax and sip back our delicious wines!

What our day includes:

  • Learn how to taste (slurp) like a pro.
  • Introduction to the Worlds major wine regions
  • Discover what makes wines taste different
  • Find out why you like some wines and not others
  • Learn how to match food with wine
  • We don't sell wine, so we'll give you tips on what and where to buy
  • 13 fabulous wines
  • Two course delicious Hotel du Vin lunch, expertly matched to wine, of course!
  • A wine-themed quiz - with a prize bottle to be won!

What to expect from the day: Other than having fun!

  • We start at 11am with fizz, followed by five further white and rosè wines.
  • Lunch is at 1pm. We send an email 5 days before the event to advise on lunch options.
  • The afternoon is a range of red wines. We select a wide range of different styles of wine - the wines differ for each event.
  • We provide good measures and will offer any remaining wine out throughout the afternoon.
  • While we do bring spittoons, most people prefer to drink the wines, so please plan not to drive afterwards!
  • We can cater to different dietary requirements for food, such as vegan and vegetarian alternatives, however we cannot guarantee that all of the wines shown will be vegan/vegetarian.
address: Hotel du Vin Birmingham, 25 Church St, Birmingham, B3 2NR

title: Spanish Wine and Tapas
description:
Spain is an intriguing mixture of old and new - winemakers are combining traditional grape varieties like Tempranillo, Garnacha, and Carinena with ‘international’ grape varieties, to produce stunning new wines. Regions such as Navarra & Ribera del Duero, are leading the charge. You will taste new wines from these and more up and coming regions (such as Rueda & Calatayud), as well as traditional Rioja, from the most improved wine producing country in Europe. Come and find out more!

Some wonderful wines, tasted with an assortment of hot and cold Tapas, beautifully prepared by the hotel chef.

Please note, we can cater for dietary requirements such as vegan or vegetarian food, but we cannot guarantee that all the wines will be vegan.
address: Hotel du Vin Birmingham, 25 Church St, Birmingham, B3 2NR
